name: Dense Prompt Graph Benchmark (DPG-Bench)
description: DPG-Bench is a challenging benchmark designed to evaluate text-to-image diffusion models on their ability to follow dense prompts involving multiple objects, detailed attributes, complex relationships, and long-text alignment. It consists of 1,000 dense prompts to assess semantic alignment and prompt-following capabilities of models.
reputation: A newer benchmark for dense prompt following in text-to-image generation that is gaining attention for evaluating compositional alignment, but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Focuses on dense prompt following in text-to-image generation; benchmark introduced alongside ELLA method.
